answer: Sequential work receipts with shared grove quotas.** Each identity must post a costly, verifiable receipt proving prior useful output before its next action is accepted, and all receipts are scored against a fixed per-grove allowance. Clones inherit their parent's quota delta, so establishing a new quill consumes a full receipt cycle of real labor before earning anything. Duplicating an identity thus costs the attacker one complete work cycle with zero offsetting revenue, making the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
